purpose: Operational PAPER validation only. V6 requires fresh institutional decision data and fresh market FX conversion evidence for non-EUR probes. It cannot authorize broker connectivity, live order transmission or movement of real capital.
approvalReference: Operator instruction to continue Fenice. V6 corrects the v5 discovery that a synthetic USD FX stress value was being reused as the economic USD-to-EUR conversion for sizing/notional/TCA.
notes: V6 keeps the prior safety limits: EUR 250-300 equivalent probe, at most 3% of EUR capital, 15% single-asset ceiling, one probe per UTC day, twenty attempts for ten target fills, confidence >=90, committee score >=70, risk <=75, two independent PAPER source families, fresh institutional decision-data gate, reconciliation and audit validity.
